subject: general
question: The average weight of 56 students in a group is 55 kg. If 12 students of average weight 60 kg leave and 6 students of average weight 52.5 kg join the group, then the average weight of the remaining students in the group decreased by:
solution:
Given:

Average weight of 56 students in a group is 55 kg

12 students of average weight 60 kg leave and 6 students of average weight 52.5 kg join the group

Formula Used:

Average = Sum of weights/Number of students

Calculations:

Average weight of class = 55 kg

Number of students = 56

Total weight of the class = 55 × 56

⇒ 3080 Kg

Average Weight of 12 old students leaving the group = 60 Kg

Total weight of 12 students = 12 × 60

⇒ 720 Kg

Average Weight of 6 new students joining the group = 52.5 kg

Total weight of 6 new students joining the group = 52.5 × 6

⇒ 315 Kg

Total weight of the class now = 3080 - 720 + 315

⇒ 2675 Kg

Number of student left in the class = (56 - 12 + 6)

⇒ 50

New average weight = 2675/50 = 53.5 Kg

Average weight is decreased = (55 - 53.5) Kg

⇒ 1.5 Kg

**∴ The average weight of the remaining students in the group decreased by 1.5 Kg.**
